description: brief --kind phase copies the progress the agent starts from to sweep/briefs/phase-<name>-<n>.progress.json and names every standing decision of the phase with its sha256; gain compares the current progress with that copy (no new step or return: gained no, exit 1; a new completed step and a newly returned label: gained yes, exit 0); standing: true is refused on a needs-decision of a fixed-option kind; show prints a bounded, filtered view of a work-folder JSON file and refuses a path outside the work folder. Only a step of the phase's own ids with its steps/ file and a label returned with its agent id count as gained. A standing decision is named only after the orchestrator records it with `standing` (bound to its sha256), and a brief refuses one whose bytes changed since.
